description: This file defines an abstract class 'FileScanBuilder' used in Apache Spark for building file scan operations with support for schema pruning and filter pushdown, within the data source V2 API.

classes.name: FileScanBuilder
classes.description: An abstract class for building file scan operations with schema pruning and filter pushdown capabilities in Spark's data source V2 API.

methods.name: pruneColumns
methods.description: Adjusts the required schema for the scan, potentially pruning nested columns.

methods.name: readDataSchema
methods.description: Determines the data schema to be read, considering schema pruning support.

methods.name: readPartitionSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the schema of partition columns.

methods.name: pushFilters
methods.description: Partitions and translates filters for pushdown, filtering out subqueries and Python UDFs.

methods.name: pushedFilters
methods.description: Returns the filters that have been pushed down in a format suitable for V2 filters.

methods.name: pushDataFilters
methods.description: Method to push down data filters to the file source; default implementation returns empty array.
